test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

The problematic and convoluted situation concerning Rakhtim’s job is likely to exhilarate in the forseeable future.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "forseeable." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ __ • The correct spelling is 'foreseeable' and let's look at the meaning. • **foreseeable** - capable of being anticipated or predicted. (पूर्वदृष्टियों से देखा जा सकने वाला) • Example: • *The situation is likely to continue for the **foreseeable **future.* • Therefore, 'forseeable' is incorrectly spelt among the given options. • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.​ ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__ • Let's know the meaning of the other options: • ​**convoluted **- extremely complex and difficult to follow or understand. (जटिल) • **problematic **- causing or likely to cause problems. (विवादास्पद, जटिल) • **exhilarate** - make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated. (उत्साहित करना) 1e8:Td793,
